description:
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Crank Shaft FRONT & REAR OIL SEALS for the Suzuki G13BA Engine.
Fits all years of Suzuki Samurai 1985-1995.
Made by SUZUKI
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Crank Shaft FRONT Oil Seal
Qty 1 – Crank Shaft REAR Oil Seal
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
